text: If it is dark, do not use your eyes.
The Quiet Hand. Part four of ten: the tunnel.
Noor waits on the far side. One point one kilometres.
Into the black. Hand on the wall.
Never shine a torch straight ahead.
They did not even flinch. Asleep.
Torch low. Beam on the rail. Eyes shut.
Light at the far end. One point one kilometres done.
Zombies do not sleep. Someone woke them.
Part four of ten, The Quiet Hand. Next: 92 percent. Follow for part five.
